name: feature-flags
title: Feature flags
description: Flags declared in site.config.ts with percentage rollouts, allow lists and env kill switches; <Feature>, isEnabled() and a /dev/flags override panel.

env.name: FLAG_OVERRIDES
env.description: Force flags on or off for everyone without a code change, e.g. "newCheckout=off,betaBanner=on"

postInstall: Declare flags in site.config.ts → flags, then: if (await isEnabled("newDashboard", user)) … or <Feature flag="newDashboard">…</Feature>.
Open /dev/flags in development to force flags on or off in your browser.
